inspection.officer_note: Plot looks neglected, many beds under sheeting.

correspondence.text: I have been unwell and could not keep up the beds.

deciding.cultivation_breach: In the growing season the covered beds count as uncultivated, so cultivated beds are 154 of 200 m2 (77%), just above 75%. Photos are missing and the illness is unverified, which leaves some doubt.
deciding.notice_ladder_met: The warning was served 2024-05-10 and its deadline was 2024-06-21, but reinspected_on is the same day as the deadline, not after it. That is borderline for a re-inspection after the deadline.
deciding.next_action: There is no exemption and the shortfall is marginal, so a warning is the likelier step. The ladder is not clearly complete, which rules out a final notice.
deciding.recurrence_count: One prior warning was issued in May 2024, and the previous visit was also at 78% cultivated. Whether that counts as the same issue logged once or is a first occurrence is unclear.
deciding.uncultivated_extent: The four covered beds total 46 of 200 m2, so 23% is uncultivated. That is just under the 25% boundary between levels 0 and 1.
